framing: native vertical 9:16, picture fills the whole tall frame edge to edge
style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, satire, bright midday sunlight
character: shaggy cream goat, amber slit eyes, curled horns, a tax notice gripped in its teeth, fills two thirds of the frame
props: a crumpled tax notice; a scrawny rooster inspector with a long receipt roll; crates of cabbages; a paper sack of carrots; the reporter hands, striped sleeve and microphone at the lens; a market awning
prop_continuity: notice whole until 4.75, chewed after; sack torn from 1.05; roll unspooling from 1.8; awning down from 8.35
motion_rule: the goat travels every window and never holds a pose, not even the last; new shot size every window, camera always moving
environment: sunlit village market row, blurred green hills behind

audio.delivery: smug chewing goat voice, mouth full, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: va-RU-yu, ye-DU, vaz-vra-SHA-yu, se-BYE, na-LO-go-vy, VY-chet, na-TU-roy
audio.pacing: steady natural tempo, never hurried; nothing said after 8.35
audio.lip_sync: jaw opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: crates clattering, paper tearing, cabbages thudding, teeth grinding

timeline.a: it bursts through the awning at the lens, notice flapping in its teeth
timeline.c: big close low on the muzzle, whip out

timeline.a: it charges down the row of crates straight into the lens
it rips the sack open on the run, carrots spraying past the lens
it swings its head and the receipt roll unspools across the glass
timeline.c: big close on the roll at the lens, push in

timeline.a: it vaults a crate stack and the rooster tumbles off its back at the lens
timeline.c: low wide racing under, whip up

timeline.a: it hauls the striped sleeve past the lens in its teeth
timeline.c: mid three quarter, whip to big close

timeline.a: it spits the notice at the glass and the hands catch it
timeline.c: big close on the muzzle, push out

timeline.a: it drives its horns under a crate and flips the crate over the lens
it runs at the lens through the falling cabbages, chewing
timeline.c: big close low on the jaw, push in

timeline.a: it snatches the microphone foam and the arm whips out of frame
timeline.c: tight low on the jaw and mic

timeline.a: the rooster shoves a fresh notice at it and it bites notice and roll through
timeline.c: big close low on the paper and jaw

timeline.a: it wheels round with a whole cabbage in its teeth and drives it into the lens
timeline.c: big close low frontal, hard push in

timeline.a: it drags the crate away through the flattened awning, receipts blizzarding off it
it wheels back and takes the camera in its teeth, the open mouth swallowing the frame
timeline.c: big close low frontal on the open mouth

must_appear: the tax notice in its teeth; the receipt roll unspooling past the lens; the striped sleeve dragged past the lens; a crate flipped over the lens; falling cabbages; a whole cabbage taken in one bite; the crate dragged away; the open mouth swallowing the final frame
negative_prompt: night, dusk, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, any lettering in frame, a square picture padded into a tall frame, blurred mirrored bars above and below the picture, letterbox, static camera, a static wide with the goat small, the goat standing behind a fence while speaking, an interview stand with the goat still, the goat holds a pose in any window, a talking head with only the jaw moving, English speech, any word after 8.35
